## Why consistency matters

A blade grinder chops beans unevenly, producing a mix of dust-like fines and large chunks. The fines over-extract and the chunks under-extract, so the cup tastes both bitter and sour.

## Burr grinders

A burr grinder crushes beans between two burrs set a fixed distance apart, giving an even particle size. Conical burrs are common in home grinders; flat burrs are common in cafe grinders.
